# Neighbour Count

Counts nearby splats or points so you can find sparse parts of your scene.

`lfs.neighbour_count` · Selection

## How to use

Connect Count to Compare to select low counts.  
Start with Radius 3 and Relative to size for splats.  
A point never counts itself.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Radius | `Radius` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; step 0.01 | Neighbour distance. 1 by default; scene units, or splat-size multiples with Relative to size. 0 counts none. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Count | `Count` | lfs.int | — | — | Number of neighbours inside Radius, excluding the point itself. 0 means isolated. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Relative To Size | `relative_to_size` | bool | false | — | Use each splat's size as the radius unit. Off by default uses scene units; points always use scene units. |
